summary: Tested the Clerk 'Secured by Clerk' bug, the Storybook 30d/90d add-on (backend and UI), admin store prices, phone tilt and regression. The bug was still there: the Manage account modal (UserProfile navbar) showed 'Secured by Clerk' and 'Development mode', because that footer uses the class .cl-footerItem, which the existing .cl-footer rules don't match. Fixed it with a one-line CSS rule in index.css and re-checked: the text no longer appears on the sign-in page (email and password steps), the UserButton popover, or Manage account (Profile and Security tabs) at desktop or mobile sizes. Every other requested feature passed.

minor.issue: After an admin save, prices come back as floats (29.0 / 69.0) because StoreIn uses float. They show fine as ₹29/₹69, but the type differs from the seeded int values.
kind=storybook with an unknown item_id (e.g. 'abc') quietly falls back to the 30d price instead of returning 400. Low risk.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Secured by Clerk' and 'Development mode' showed at the bottom of the navbar (.cl-footerItem). FIXED by the testing agent in index.css.

issues: The badge says 'ADD-ON · ₹29 FOR 30 DAYS' and the copy only mentions ₹29/30 days. Consider mentioning the ₹69 / 90-day option.
The faint orange dev-mode stripe pattern from Clerk is still visible at the bottom of the navbar. This is dev-instance only and goes away with production keys.

action_items: Keep the testing agent's CSS rule at the bottom of index.css (.cl-footerItem, .cl-navbar [class*="cl-footer"] ...) or merge it into your Clerk overrides.
Optional: return 400 for an invalid storybook item_id in /billing/quote.
Optional: mention the 90-day bundle in the pricing Storybook section copy.
critical_code_review_comments: Hiding the Clerk branding with CSS is fragile because Clerk class names change between versions. The appearance prop (layout: { unsafe_disableDevelopmentModeWarnings: true }) and branding settings in the Clerk dashboard are more robust ways to remove the dev-mode text. 'Secured by Clerk' can only be removed officially on a paid plan.

useDeviceTilt sets the beta baseline from the first event and never resets it. If the user changes how they hold the phone a lot, the card stays clamped at one edge. Consider re-basing after orientationchange.
Sign-in card renders no .cl-footerActionLink ('Sign up' link). Confirm this is intentional.

success_rate.frontend: 100% after the CSS fix (Clerk bug failed before it)

seed_data_creation: None. Admin store storybook_bundle_price was temporarily set to 70 via the UI and restored to 69.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Clerk check: sign in, open .cl-userButtonTrigger, then Manage account, and check that document.body.innerText contains neither 'Secured by' nor 'Development mode'. Tilt check: use a new_context with has_touch/is_mobile, dispatch Event('deviceorientation') with beta/gamma, and read [data-testid=hero-card-main] style.transform. The flip element is the hero-card-main > div.relative. Use curl rather than urllib for public API checks (urllib gets a 403).
